nodes.title: Prompt_pos
widgets_values:
Cinematic photorealistic environmental scene of a woman working behind the counter of a small traditional bakery early in the morning.

Shown from approximately mid-thigh upward, her body is turned about 30 degrees away from the camera while her head is turned slightly toward a customer outside the frame. Her face remains clearly visible in a natural three-quarter view, but she is not looking into the camera.

She is reaching sideways with one hand to place a loaf of bread into a paper bag while the other hand rests on the wooden counter. Natural working posture, subtle movement, relaxed asymmetry in shoulders and arms.

She has thick dark naturally curly hair loosely tied back, with several curls falling around the face. She wears a simple rust-colored blouse with rolled sleeves and a dark linen apron.

Warm early-morning sunlight enters through the shop window from the side, creating directional light across the face and realistic soft shadows.

Behind her are wooden bread shelves, baskets, flour-dusted surfaces and a softly visible bakery interior. Environmental context remains clearly recognizable.

Natural candid moment, environmental photography rather than a formal portrait, realistic skin texture, natural facial proportions, fine skin detail and imperfections, realistic hands, detailed hair strands, cinematic photography, photorealistic.
She is arranging freshly cut wildflowers in a large ceramic vase, one hand holding several stems while the other rests near the vase. Natural relaxed posture, subtle asymmetry in shoulders and arms.

She wears a simple dark green linen blouse with rolled-up sleeves, understated jewelry, natural appearance.

Large industrial windows beside her provide soft directional afternoon light, illuminating one side of her face while the opposite side remains naturally shadowed. Warm sunlight, realistic skin texture, fine pores, natural wrinkles and imperfections, detailed hair strands.

The studio contains wooden shelves, ceramic objects, brushes and unfinished paintings, softly visible in the background. Shallow but not extreme depth of field, environmental context remains recognizable.

Three-quarter upper-body composition, slightly off-center framing, natural candid moment rather than a formal portrait, realistic proportions, cinematic photography, highly detailed, photorealistic.
